title: Multiple Sensors
summary: Living creatures do not rely on just one sense.

steps.title: Multiple Sensors

quickCheck.question: Which C++ logical operator requires BOTH sensor conditions to be true before executing an `if` block?
quickCheck.explanation: The && operator evaluates to true only when both conditions on either side are true simultaneously.
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: From Coding Foundations: && means both must be true, while || means either one can be true.

quickCheck.question: If you want a robot alarm to sound if a collision switch hits an obstacle OR a distance sensor reads under 5 cm, which operator should connect the conditions?
quickCheck.explanation: The || (OR) operator triggers the action if either one of the conditions is met.
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Use || when either warning signal is enough to trigger the protective response!
